Author:     Corey Bryant <corey@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Fri Mar 7 09:58:47 2025 +0000
Commit:     Corey Bryant <corey@thunderbird.net>

    Bug 1951683 - Use system python3 to create venv in make_venv.sh. r=dandarnell
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D240341

diff --git a/taskcluster/docker/recipes/make_venv.sh b/taskcluster/docker/recipes/make_venv.sh
index e6308c3bc17..e4155c6906d 100755
--- a/taskcluster/docker/recipes/make_venv.sh
+++ b/taskcluster/docker/recipes/make_venv.sh
@@ -18,6 +18,6 @@ VENV_NAME=${2:-"venv"}
 mkdir -p "$VENV_DIR" && cd "$VENV_DIR"
 
 # Create Python virtual environment and install dependencies
-python3 -m venv --system-site-packages "$VENV_NAME"
+/usr/bin/python3 -m venv --system-site-packages "$VENV_NAME"
 source "./$VENV_NAME/bin/activate"
 python3 -m pip install -r "$1"
